ZTE.why: Makes AI servers, storage, OEX supernodes, data-center infrastructure and AI-computing data-center switches sold to Chinese internet companies, carriers, banks and enterprises; its computing-products revenue rises with AI data-center build-out.
ZTE.evidence: ZTE half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026): government and enterprise revenue RMB 27,631,306 thousand, up 43.51%, mainly due to growth in server and storage revenue; it offers supernodes, AI-computing servers, storage and 12.8T-460.8T AI switches.

players.product: AI servers and storage: OEX orthogonal-architecture supernodes (up to 128 GPUs per rack), AI-computing and general-purpose servers, high-performance storage, modular / AIDC data-center solutions

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (half-year report, RMB thousand): revenue RMB 78,025,359 thousand, up 9.05% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,752,825 thousand, down 45.57%; gross margin 25.48%, down 6.97 points. By business: carrier networks RMB 31,765,129 thousand (-9.41%, gross margin 38.06%, mainly lower wireless revenue), government and enterprise RMB 27,631,306 thousand (+43.51%, gross margin 15.84%), consumer RMB 18,628,924 thousand (+8.09%). International revenue RMB 27,871,543 thousand, up 33.13%, 35.72% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 78,025,359 thousand (+9.05%); net profit RMB 2,752,825 thousand (-45.57%)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: government and enterprise revenue rose 43.51% mainly due to growth in server and storage revenue, and its gross margin rose 7.57 points mainly because server and storage gross margin improved; the company calls it its core revenue-growth engine. Servers and storage kept winning and delivering projects at leading internet companies at scale, broke through with AI-computing products at state-owned and joint-stock banks (general-compute products won at scale) and won or gained share with key customers in power, transport, government and large enterprises; overseas it deepened stable cooperation with Chinese companies going abroad. In carrier compute networks, servers and storage kept leading positions in the domestic general-compute x86 ecosystem and the CUDA-like AI-computing ecosystem and landed multiple AI resource-pool projects. Data center: customised services for leading internet companies at home; overseas its self-developed products reached scaled deployment with a local customer in Indonesia while it expands into Malaysia, Thailand, Japan and Mexico.
quarterly_data.figure: Government and enterprise revenue +43.51%; gross margin +7.57 points

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: its AI-computing supernode products use a front-loaded whole-system development model that takes only 3~6 months from requirement confirmation to whole-system delivery. The company has developed its own domain-specific processor chips, the Dinghai DPU chip, switch chips, converged gateway chips, optical-access processor chips (50G PON) and an 800G coherent DSP chip, which have shipped to carriers, internet companies and other industries.
quarterly_data.figure: 3~6 months from requirement confirmation to supernode delivery

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: as the originator (its claim) of the modular data center, ZTE offers a full series of prefabricated modular data-center solutions plus AC/DC integrated power modules, full-scenario AI energy-efficiency tuning and assembled data centers; its data-center products have more than 500 project cases worldwide, more than 40 ten-thousand (wan) racks deployed and over 350 ten-thousand (wan) square meters of machine-room area.
quarterly_data.figure: 500+ data-center project cases; 40+ ten-thousand racks deployed

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: remaining performance obligations (contracts signed but not yet fully performed) were RMB 23,705,499 thousand at 30 June 2026, of which RMB 15,647,525 thousand is expected to be recognised within one year; the comparable 2025 column shows RMB 22,031,725 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Remaining performance obligations RMB 23,705,499 thousand (30 June 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook for H2 2026 (half-year report): AI compute demand keeps growing fast and supernodes are accelerating into commercial deployment, but the commercial closed loop of the AI-computing business is still being cultivated, uncertainty over price fluctuations of raw materials such as memory remains, and domestic carrier network investment is still affected by the industry cycle. In carrier networks it will draw on network, optical-transport and compute-interconnect technology to join carriers' compute-network integration as their supernode, AI resource-pool, inference and cross-domain scheduling demand grows. In government and enterprise it aims to make the segment the core engine of revenue growth: accelerate scaled use of its self-developed compute chips and supernode solutions with leading internet companies and finance, power and transport customers, strengthen cost control to balance revenue and profit, and abroad deepen cooperation with Chinese companies going overseas.

Half-year report: RMB 11,960,967 thousand of H1 2026 revenue came from one major customer (carrier-network and consumer revenue), versus RMB 16,482,162 thousand from one major customer in H1 2025; the customer is not named. The top five customers by receivables and contract assets held 39.41% of that balance (a share of receivables, not of sales).
quarterly_data.figure: One major customer RMB 11,960,967 thousand of H1 2026 revenue (name not disclosed)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 R&D investment RMB 11,750,739 thousand (-13.22%), 15.06% of revenue; capex RMB 2,490,573 thousand (mainly equipment, capitalised R&D and own office buildings) versus RMB 2,087,438 thousand a year earlier. Inventory was RMB 54,645,606 thousand at 30 June 2026 versus RMB 47,017,122 thousand at end-2025, and accounts payable rose 42.76% mainly because material purchases increased.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 11,750,739 thousand (15.06% of revenue); capex RMB 2,490,573 thousand; inventory RMB 54,645,606 thousand

players.product: data-center switches: 12.8T-460.8T box and chassis AI-computing switches for 400GE/800GE lossless RoCE networks

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: its Nebula (Xingyun) AI-computing network solution offers a full series of 12.8T/51.2T/115.2T/230.4T/460.8T box and chassis AI-computing switches for end-to-end decoupled 400GE/800GE lossless AI networks (a domestic leader, its claim); triple flow-control innovations give up to 98% network throughput efficiency inside AI data centers and 5μs-level congestion tuning, and the switches are in scaled commercial use in hundred-, thousand- and ten-thousand-card AI clusters in carrier, internet and power markets. In H1 2026 it raised share in domestic carriers' new public-cloud general-compute market, landed a white-box switch project at a leading internet company and won a new joint-stock bank project in finance, while keeping its lead in the power industry.
quarterly_data.figure: 12.8T-460.8T switch series; up to 98% network throughput efficiency

quarterly_data.signal: Customer China Mobile (half-year report): in H1 2026 ZTE won China Mobile's RoCE switch centralized procurement project.
